newsitem.title: USA: Texas Biotechnology starts Phase I trial.
newsitem.headline: Texas Biotechnology starts Phase I trial.

text.p: Texas Biotechnology Corp said on Wednesday it started a Phase I clinical trial in the United Kingdom for TBC 11251, a drug to treat congestive heart failure.
TBC 11251 is designed to help improve cardiac function in patients with congestive heart failure by blocking endothelin activity and decreasing vascular resistance to blood flow.

Texas Biotech said it plans to file an Investigational New Drug application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration by the end of the fourth quarter of 1996 to begin additional clinical trials in the United States in 1997.
